caption: Castel dell'Ovo, Naples
composition: Fortress on Megaride islet with Vesuvius beyond · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the lamplit seafront promenade at the left, the view crosses the marina to Castel dell'Ovo, its tuff walls and towers glowing warm on the Megaride islet at center-right. Behind it rises the broad cone of Vesuvius under a pink-streaked dawn sky, with moored boats scattered across the calm bay. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 06:58 Europe/Rome: sunrise light, not a verified on-site observation.
